dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
CMD ["python", "-c", "print('Playwright with Black formatting ready')"]
explanation: Generated requirements.txt with the latest stable version of Black (23.3.0) for code formatting. Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim base, installs dependencies from requirements.txt, and sets up a simple Python execution environment. Note: Playwright itself isn't included since only 'black' was detected in imports.
